itemUsage.en: Lungmen Guard Department Commissioner Swire, fresh off her holiday in Siesta.
itemUsage.zh: 龙门近卫局局长诗怀雅，刚刚结束在汐斯塔的度假。

itemDesc.en: She brought back more than impulse purchases—she's got business opportunities that'll shake up the market.
itemDesc.zh: 她带回来的不止因心动购入的商品，还有能够撬动市场的商机。

description.en:
Spends <@ba.vup>1</> Coin: the next attack restores HP equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</> of ATK to a friendly unit within the surrounding 8 tiles with less than 70% HP
<@ba.rem>A maximum of 1 Coin may be held while this Skill is equipped</>
description.zh: 消耗<@ba.vup>一枚</>金币，下一次攻击会为周围八格内血量不足70%的一名友方单位恢复相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</>的生命\n<@ba.rem>携带此技能时金币上限为1</>

description.en:
Spends <@ba.vup>1</> Coin to place a Champagne Bomb on a ground tile within range that is passable and can be deployed upon; the Champagne Bomb deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage to the first target it comes in contact with, and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> for <@ba.vup>{sluggish}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>The Champagne Bomb deals additional damage after having been deployed for 3 seconds; a maximum of 3 Coins may be held while this Skill is equipped</>
description.zh: 消耗<@ba.vup>一枚</>金币在范围内一个可放置且可通行的地面放置香槟炸弹，香槟炸弹会对触碰到的首个敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害，并使目标<$ba.sluggish>停顿</><@ba.vup>{sluggish}</>秒\n<@ba.rem>香槟炸弹在场3秒后可额外造成一次伤害；携带此技能时金币上限为3</>

description.en:
Attacks hit twice, and gain 1 Coin upon defeating an enemy; when skill is manually deactivated, <@ba.vup>all</> Coins will be spent to randomly attack enemies in a frontal area. Each Coin spent in this manner hits once for <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage and knocks the target back <@ba.vup>slightly</>
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration, can be manually deactivated at any time; a maximum of 10 Coins may be held while this Skill is equipped</>
description.zh: 攻击变为二连击，击倒敌人时获得一枚金币；主动关闭技能时消耗<@ba.vup>所有</>金币对前方范围内敌人随机攻击，每消耗一枚金币造成一次相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害，并将目标<@ba.vup>小力地</>向前推开\n<@ba.rem>持续时间无限，可随时主动关闭技能；携带此技能时金币上限为10</>

description.en:
'With unsurpassed strategic thinking, a mindset for acute initiative, and an attitude showing they care about the human side of things, Mountaincomm Trade has opened up international markets, injecting new life into Siesta's economy and marketplace. I quote Beatrix Schwire's own words—the value of business is in building connections, and the greatest activity a business can undertake is connecting with the future.'
—Award speech, Siesta's 1099 Annual Award for Outstanding Figures in Business
Ceylon Doykos personally awarded Swire this medal at Siesta City Hall's annual dinner, and now it's just one of a jumble of keepsakes she's brought back from Siesta to Lungmen.
'You went to Siesta for a holiday, and took this home with you?' Hoshiguma asks curiously, poring over the Columbian on the certificate.
'The greatest activity a business can undertake is connecting with the future'—I'm putting that in my autobiography.'
'This certificate really tells a wild story... And you managed to do all this in just under two months? What does 'opened up international markets' mean exactly?'
'Siesta's coffee beans were moving slow this year, so I made a few friends and sold off a massive shipment to Kazimierz—did you want to try some? I still have some in my bag.'
'And can you translate 'an attitude that shows they care about the human side of things'?'
'I did a little investing, and got the volcanic hot springs there transformed into a waterpark. Everyone seemed to take quite a liking.'
'Okay, and 'a mindset for acute initiative' refers to...'
'There were an awful lot of firms warring for Siesta's urban construction. Winning the final bid obviously took doing a little something to stand out.'
'So how did you win?'
'On vacation. Which is where that story is staying.'
'Uh-huh...'
'Stop reading that and help me sort my gifts out. This surfboard is for you, here's a volcanic mud cleanser for that stinky rat, here's a vinyl for that puk gaai lung—you know what, she can fetch it herself when she gets back—and here's some fruit cans for old Wei...'
The two spend all afternoon sorting through the pile of memorabilia, until finally, the only thing left lying forlornly on the ground is that medal.
'Are you putting this on display? I don't know, your cabinet's already full with all your other awards...'
'Forget it, this one can be a present for that sick old tiger—I'm visiting the hospital tomorrow, so I'll just give it to him myself.' Swire puts the medal away in her handbag, then stretches delightedly.
'As the representative of Lungmen's future, I'm going to go connect with him.'
description.zh:
“峯联贸易以卓越的战略思维、锐意进取的态度、充满人文关怀的姿态，打开了国际市场，为汐斯塔经济市场注入了新的活力。正如碧翠克斯·施怀雅女士本人所说，商业的价值，在于沟通，而最伟大的商业活动，是与未来沟通。”
——汐斯塔1099年度杰出商业人物颁奖词
汐斯塔市政厅的年度晚会上，锡兰·道尔科斯亲手将奖牌颁发给了诗怀雅，如今它正混在诗怀雅从汐斯塔带回龙门的一大堆伴手礼中。
“你去汐斯塔度了一次假，还顺带拿了这个东西回来？”星熊看着证书上的哥伦比亚语，好奇地问道。
“‘最伟大的商业活动，是与未来沟通’——我要把这句话记在我的自传里。”
“这证书上写的，好厉害啊……不到两个月的时间，你能做这么多事？‘打开国际市场’是什么意思？”
“我找了些门道，帮忙把汐斯塔今年滞销的一大批咖啡豆卖到了卡西米尔去——你要尝尝吗？我包里还有一些。”
“‘人文关怀的姿态’又是在说什么？”
“做了一点投资，把那里的火山温泉改造成了水上乐园，大家都还挺喜欢的。”
“那，‘锐意进取的态度’指的是……”
“竞标汐斯塔城建的公司有很多家，想要最终得标，当然得做点够突出的事。”
“那你是怎么赢的？”
“道上的事，别多打听。”
“嗯……”
“别看那个了，快帮我分分礼物。这是给你的冲浪板，这是给臭老鼠的火山泥面膜，这是给扑街龙的唱片——等她回来自己拿吧，还有给老魏的水果罐头……”
两人花了一下午将堆成小山的纪念品整理归类，最终只剩那块奖牌孤零零地躺在地上。
“这个要找地方摆起来吗？可我看你这里的柜子好像都被别的奖杯塞满了……”
“不用了，这个就当做给老病虎的礼物吧——明天去医院，我自己带给他。”诗怀雅将奖牌收进随身的包里，伸了一个愉快的懒腰。
“代表龙门的未来，去和他沟通一下。”

name.zh: 诗怀雅的龙门美食指南

description.en:
Pinned Casual Chat Group (4)
16:26
Guma: i'm hungry. what's for dinner?
Swire: Let's eat somewhere nice. How about the Lungmen Grand Hotel at 8:00 PM? You guys have to try their new poon choi. It's made traditionally, but the ingredients come from a new trade route that Mountaincomm Trade just opened. You'll get flavors from Rim Billiton to Sargon, and it's all super fresh. It even comes with a bottle of wine from Sami!
Swire: Bison and I worked really hard to get this supply line up and running, so you all have to come! @Stinky Rat
Stinky Rat: Am I invited?
17:09
Guma: i'm starving. can we just go now?
Swire: There aren't any seats yet. Have a snack to tide you over!
18:32
Guma: so hungry...
19:20
Guma: starving...
19:58
Stinky Rat: Something just came up. You guys eat first.
20:08
Swire: Huh?
Swire: What about Hoshiguma?
20:23
Swire: It's been ages since we all last met up—we HAVE to eat together. Finish up whatever it is you're doing, then decide where we're going to eat!
20:41
Swire: So, what are we gonna eat?
21:19
Swire: What are we eating tonight???
Swire: Lin Yühsia, I can see you on read! Hurry up and pick a place!
Stinky Rat: I just finished up. Besides, you're the one who put out that 'Director Swire's Lungmen Food Guide'. It's been blaring nonstop on TV for three days. And I'm the one that has to pick the restaurant?
Guma: sorry, emergency mission. done now. i'll eat whatever, as long as there's meat. i'm so hungry i could eat a burdenbeast
Stinky Rat: How about the night market? 'Right next to the shopping district, featuring specialty items from all over Terra. Shop at all of Terra, only in Lungmen!' Pretty good marketing copy, don't you think?
Swire: Great choice! I have to promote my work, after all!
Guma: doesn't sound like much meat. pass
Swire: The volcanic mud cleansing face mask I gave you is on sale there too, @Stinky Rat. And the surfboard @Guma.
Swire: Bison and I bargained day and night, and now they cost almost the same as they do in Siesta. Smart, huh?
Guma: don't wanna eat a surfboard
Stinky Rat: How about the Global Commerce Park? It's second on your food guide list.
Swire: That could work. We're working to attract investors over there, and we have a lot of international vendors now. The food's good too.
Guma: i want meat, and that's over half an hour away. i'll starve on the way
Swire: Well that's a shame. Young folks love that place—it's a top date spot!
Stinky Rat: Enough!
Stinky Rat: Final offer: the noodle cart behind the L.G.D. station. If that's no good, you two can starve.
Guma: fine by me
Swire: Fine by me.
21:30
Swire: Wait, Lin Yühsia, how did you get my food guide? Weren't you complaining about my TV ads?
Stinky Rat: I just grabbed one. Is that a problem?
21:33
Stinky Rat: How come the noodle cart isn't on your food guide?
Swire: I wanted to include it, but the owner refused. He said something about how he didn't want his humble stall to be viewed as a sellout and lose its authenticity.
Swire: Which is great, in my opinion. In the end, that's what Lungmen is all about.
21:38
Guma: i've already ordered. hurry up
23:35
Guma: why hasn't chen read a single message?
Swire: Try the intercity net. She's probably standing on a pile of hay in the middle of nowhere, holding up her terminal to catch a signal.
—New Message—
Puk Gaai Lung: ...
Puk Gaai Lung: It's a pile of rocks.
Puk Gaai Lung: I'm back in Lungmen. I'm up for noodles.
description.zh:
【置顶】平时聊天群（4）
16:26
熊熊：我饿了，晚上吃啥？
诗怀雅：吃点好的，龙门大饭店，晚上八点！你们一定要尝那个创新盆菜，是老做法，但食材是峯联贸易新开的那条物流线运来的。从雷姆必拓到萨尔贡你都能吃到，而且绝对新鲜，套餐还赠一瓶萨米来的酒！
诗怀雅：这可是我和拜松忙上忙下好不容易开的物流线，你们一定要来！@臭老鼠 
臭老鼠：还有我的份？
17:09
熊熊：很饿，我们能现在去吗？
诗怀雅：现在没位子呀，你先吃点垫一下！
18:32
熊熊：好饿……
19:20
熊熊：饿啊……
19:58
臭老鼠：临时有件急事，你们先吃
20:08
诗怀雅：啊？
诗怀雅：那星熊人呢？
20:23
诗怀雅：好久没见了今天一定要和你们一起吃一顿，忙完了快想想吃什么！
20:41
诗怀雅：晚上吃什么？
21:19
诗怀雅：晚上吃什么？？
诗怀雅：林雨霞我看到你已读了！快说吃什么？
臭老鼠：刚刚忙完。你刚出了《诗怀雅的龙门美食指南》，电视台连播三天吵得我耳朵疼，还要我来定吗？
熊熊：我紧急任务结束了。吃啥都行有肉就行。我现在饿得能吃下一头驮兽
臭老鼠：去小吃街？“旁边还有商品街，汇聚泰拉各地特色商品。只在龙门，买遍泰拉！”挺会写啊
诗怀雅：那当然，这可都是我的工作成果，当然要好好宣传
熊熊：听起来肉很少，不要
诗怀雅：我送你的火山泥面膜现在在那也能买到@臭老鼠 冲浪板也是@熊熊 
诗怀雅：我和拜松把价格打到只比在汐斯塔当地贵一点，可以吧？
熊熊：我不想吃冲浪板
臭老鼠：那国际商业园？指南里排第二
诗怀雅：也行？我们正在那边招商引资，进驻了不少国外商家，餐厅味道也好
熊熊：我想吃肉，从我这去那里要半个多小时，我会饿死的
诗怀雅：可惜，小年轻们可喜欢那了，是约会圣地呢
臭老鼠：烦死了！
臭老鼠：我最后说一个，近卫局楼后面的那个车仔面摊，不成的话你们两个饿死算了
熊熊：我没意见
诗怀雅：我没意见
21:30
诗怀雅：等等，林雨霞你怎么有我的美食指南，你不是嫌活动很吵吗？
臭老鼠：顺手拿的，不行？
21:33
臭老鼠：车仔面摊怎么没在美食指南上？
诗怀雅：我要写来着，老板不让。说什么那边有万国繁华，这边有路灯小摊，他平平淡淡才是真
诗怀雅：我觉得也不错，这才是龙门嘛
21:38
熊熊：我已经点好了，速来
23:35
熊熊：陈怎么一条消息都没看？
诗怀雅：连城际网络才行。说不定她正在哪个山沟里站在破草堆上，举着终端四处蹭信号呢
——新消息——
扑街龙：……
扑街龙：是破石头堆
扑街龙：我回龙门了，我也要吃车仔面

name.en: Swire the Elegant Wit's Specialized Badge

description.en:
In light of special permissions granted,
the Field Operations Department has hence passed the following resolution with respect to Swire the Elegant Wit:
Where the entailing mission would fall under Integrated Strategies scope, this operator shall be pursuant to tactics of a reinforced nature in meeting the enemy.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
'For crying out loud, you wasted my time, you punk!'
description.zh:
琳琅诗怀雅已获得特别认证许可
根据外勤部门决议
在集成战略行动中以改良策略应对敌人
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明
“真是的，浪费我时间，扑街仔。”
